## Core Value Proposition
Accelerance Tech eliminates the silos between creative agencies, IT subcontractors, and media buying firms. We assemble senior, cross-functional delivery pods composed of full-stack software architects, brand and UI/UX designers, conversion optimization analysts, and DevOps engineers. Every digital asset is engineered for verifiable commercial outcomes: lower acquisition costs, higher conversion velocity, and organic search dominance.

## Engineering Stack & Technology Disciplines
- **Frontend Architecture**: Next.js 14/15 (App Router, Server Components, SSG, ISR), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP Animation Suite
- **eCommerce Platforms**: Headless Shopify (Storefront API, Liquid, Hydrogen), WooCommerce, Magento, Custom Node.js & Next.js eCommerce Engines
- **Mobile Engineering**: Flutter (Dart) for high-performance iOS and Android compilation, React Native, Firebase, SQLite, Native Device APIs
- **Artificial Intelligence**: Autonomous AI Agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases (Pinecone, pgvector)
- **CRM & RevOps**: HubSpot Certified (Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Operations Hub), Salesforce integrations, custom webhook synchronizers
- **Cloud Infrastructure & Security**: AWS (ECS, Lambda, CloudFront, S3), Vercel, Google Cloud Platform, Cloudflare CDN/WAF, Docker, CI/CD GitHub Actions
